title: Pinecone API key (pcsk_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 4-character label, below the 5-6 the contract requires and length: a 62-character secret segment vs the 63 the contract requires. Twin of "Pinecone API key (pcsk_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of pinecone-api-key-twin-base-dotenv: length: a 62-character secret segment vs the 63 the contract requires. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
